title: Starter · Posterized

environment.description: A packed indoor basketball arena at night, bright court lighting, roaring crowd in tiered stands, center-hung jumbotron. Only two teams are on the court: the Comfy team in electric blue and yellow, and the rival team in black and neon green. No white, red or other jerseys anywhere.
environment.style: Photoreal live-action sports broadcast. Crisp arena light, glossy hardwood reflections, shallow depth of field on close-ups, fast shutter freezing the action.

shots.title: Fast break
shots.description: Wide arena shot as @comfy-guard sprints the ball up the court on a fast break, @comfy-wing and @comfy-center filling the lanes, the rival defenders backpedalling, the crowd on its feet.

shots.title: The drive
shots.description: Low tracking shot alongside as @comfy-guard drives hard along the baseline past @rival-defender, crossing the ball between his legs, sneakers squeaking.

shots.title: Posterized
shots.description: Low angle under the rim: @comfy-guard explodes upward and throws down a two-handed dunk over @rival-defender, the net snaps, the camera rises with him, the arena erupts.
